$comment: Per-release-line settings for the 27.0.x maintenance line. This file is the ONLY thing that differs between main and a maintenance branch - the release scripts themselves are identical everywhere, so they can be cherry-picked between branches without conflicts. See build-tools/MAINTENANCE-RELEASE.md and build-tools/HOTFIX.md.
$comment2: forkBleedingEdgeBranch is a branch name rather than the null a maintenance line normally uses: the CVE-2026-16633 backport was applied to BOTH channels by explicit decision, so this line keeps a bleeding-edge bundle of its own (engine 5.6.1114) alongside the stable one (5.6.1115). Setting it to null would build both bundles from the stable branch and contradict the committed sbom.json.
